project.name: XMage Nexus
project.tagline: Modern, polished web client for XMage (React 19 + TypeScript + WebSocket proxy).
project.stack: XMage Server 1.4.62-V1 · Mage.Proxy (Java 17) · React 19 + Vite + TS

release.notes: v0.4.3: upgrades the XMage engine to 1.4.62-V1 (beta.xmage.today) and ships rebuilt components (server + proxy) from the nexus fork. Upstream 1.4.62 fixes the oneway thread-pool leak itself, so the fork delegation patch is dropped; golden frames and all contract guards were re-recorded against 1.4.62.
highlights: XMage 1.4.62-V1: new sets/cards and engine fixes from upstream
Thread-pool leak fix now comes from upstream (idle thread expiry) - the nexus one-file patch is retired
All 119+ golden frames re-recorded against 1.4.62 and validated (contract + replay)
Components are rebuilt in this release (server + proxy 1.4.62)
Dual server flavors (beta + XDHS) keep working; XDHS still uses its own 1.5.8 engine

phases.name: XMage Proxy (bridge)
phases.desc: Java 17 proxy, WebSocket gateway, cycle-safe JSON serializer, multi-tenant sessions.

phases.name: Web Client: login + lobby + board
phases.desc: React 19 + Vite, lobby, chat, live tables/users, HD card cache, 1v1 board + spectator.

phases.name: Full Interaction
phases.desc: London mulligan, priority loops, visual targeting, mana payment, combat UI, X-costs, modals, counters. Live 2026-09-12: tokens (Dragon Fodder), auras (Rancor), counters (Ballista X=2), planeswalkers (Jace +2/Brainstorm), equipment + evasion (Serra flying/vigilance/haste/shroud), order dialogs, Bo3 sideboard via raw WS (UI submit validated live 2026-09-18; see COMPONENT_PARITY U4/U11).

phases.name: 1v1 Competitive Parity
phases.desc: Card selection modals (HD CardGrid), phase stops/shortcuts (F4-F11; F1 does not exist by design), match clocks, DFCs/Sagas, interactive discard from revealed hand (Thoughtseize). Live 2026-09-12: no-clock timer hidden via isUnlimitedTime, singular pile viewer, spectator game chat, honest seat/password error paths.

phases.name: Visual Polish, Audio & Deck Builder
phases.desc: Web Audio engine (22 sfx, 4 buses incl. adaptive generative music), VFX (donut color pie, bars, shake, spell-weight slam, hit sparks, destroy/exile/token deaths, low-life vignette, foil + 3D-tilt preview, cinematic end screen with match stats), selectable playmats (7 static + 2 animated, one tinted by colour identity), in-app deck builder (Scryfall full syntax t:creature c:red cmc<=3 o:haste, help, 9-lang, curve+donut, vertical CMC sort, plain/dck/arena export+clipboard, file drag-drop, goldfish T1-3).

phases.name: Desktop Packaging (Tauri)
phases.desc: Tauri launcher (Windows/macOS/Linux) with server + proxy + jlinked JRE on first run and signed auto-updater (latest.json); published as v0.1.0 (2026-09-10), v0.2.0 (2026-09-19), v0.3.0 (2026-09-27), v0.4.0 (2026-09-30), v0.4.1 (2026-10-01, beta + XDHS flavors), v0.4.2 (2026-10-02, signed macOS bundle) and v0.4.3 (2026-10-04, XMage 1.4.62-V1 with rebuilt components). Clean-machine install validation (SmartScreen/Gatekeeper) still tracked in plan5 V7.

phases.name: Advanced Formats & Tournaments
phases.desc: Commander pod (PodBoard 2x2 render clamp 4 — server supports FFA 3-10 — + TurnOrderRing + CommanderDamageMatrix), Booster Draft & Sealed (8-player, DraftScreen + ConstructScreen), Swiss/SE brackets (TournamentBracket/Panel) + Replay entry from the match history (view-only; transport controls pending). Live 2026-09-13: Sealed Elimination end-to-end (audit-sealed-2, joinTournament discovery, auto-submit, 40-card game to Finished) + tournament wizard with real data (19 types). Draft picks and sealed ConstructScreen submit via web UI validated live 2026-09-14.

phases.name: Wizard Crear Mesa — cierre de gaps vs desktop NewTableDialog
phases.desc: NumPlayers (min/max del oráculo, Commander/FFA 3-10), asientos por plaza SeatConfig[] (tipo+deck), validación deck↔game (port checkMatchOptions), limited fix F8 + limited:true, wins 1-5, mulligans 0-5, persistencia mage_createTable_v1, proxy contrato extendido (mulliganType/customLife/Hand/planeChase/bannedUsers), Custom Options UI (badge Custom(n)), draft exhaustive 21 tournamentTypes + 46 draftCubes (draftCubeName), simDecks por plaza. Delta 2026-09-06: skill por plaza 1-10 (seatSkills web→SimManager→SimPlayer) + skill propia, UI de vetados y de rondas (0=auto), range/attack por flags del servidor, validación por paso, hint vivo por plaza. F11: plazas HUMAN en espera (solo-humanos, tipos normalizados a enum canónico). F6 emblemas fuera de alcance. Docs history/lobby_roadmap §F, oráculo server-state-schema.json.

features.feature: 1v1 Table Creation (Human/AI) — wizard fits the viewport at 100% zoom; edit the selected deck from the Seats step
Text / Arena / Standard Import & Export (file picker first, detected format marked in the select, bulk printing resolution, legality review)
Hand, Battlefield (HD Art) — card overlay toggles: hand cost pips, P/T badge, summoning-sickness indicator
Commander / EDH (server FFA 3-10; board render clamp 4)

guards.name: callbackCoverage
guards.desc: Every server callback has a client handler or is listed as planned.

guards.name: mechanicsCoverage
guards.desc: Every mage.view.* field the server can emit is modeled in contract.schema.json / types.generated.ts (reverse-drift).

guards.name: engineViewCoverage
guards.desc: Engine state in mage.game.* not copied into mage.view.* DTOs is tracked against a baseline.
guards.note: Known gaps: harnessed / monstrous / renowned / player-targeting. goad shown via cardIcons/rules (not a gap). Guard: web/src/state/engineViewCoverage.test.ts + scripts/engine-view-schema.mjs

guards.name: serverStateCoverage
guards.desc: CreateTable formats (gameTypes/deckTypes) are exhaustive vs Mage.Server/config/config.xml — no drift when offline/fake.
